name: UCLA Health Westwood High School Summer Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help patients and visitors at the hospital. Tasks include moving patients, helping people find their way at entrances and wheelchair help. You can also deliver patient mail and newspapers.
who_can_apply: Must be 16 by June 1. Grade and residency are not stated. A government photo ID and immunization proof are required.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Parking is not free for student volunteers.
duration: At least 50 hours, finished by August 31
deadline_text: The page says the High School Summer Program is now closed. Information for Summer 2027 will be posted starting January 1, 2027. Hours must be done by August 31.
how_to_apply: Sign up for a required Zoom info session. You get the form by email. Send it back with proof of shots (varicella, MMR, TB test). Then go to one required in-person orientation. Email studentvol@mednet.ucla.edu.
notes: Info sessions fill fast. Every slot showed FULL or CLOSED when read. The page also points to the Mattel Youth Ambassador program as another option. Santa Monica and West Valley campuses have their own student pages.
